name: Active Investor Plus Visa

qualifying_event.description: A residence-by-investment route requiring NZD 15 million in acceptable New Zealand investments over a 4-year period (or NZD 5 million if invested entirely in the Direct Investment category), split across direct investments, managed funds, and/or listed equities/philanthropy sub-categories, each with its own minimum.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of investment funds/source; investment placement evidence across qualifying categories; minimum days present in NZ during the 4-year investment period.

requirements.blocker_text: NZD 15 million (or the weighted equivalent) in acceptable New Zealand investments, drawn across Direct Investment (min. NZD 100,000), Managed Funds (min. NZD 500,000), and Listed Equities/Philanthropy (min. NZD 1 million) sub-categories.
At least 117 days physically present in New Zealand as a resident-visa holder during the 4-year investment period.
NZD 5 million qualifies if invested exclusively in the Direct Investment category.

evidence_required.document: Proof of investment funds and legitimate source
Travel records proving days present in NZ

outcome.duration_length: resident visa held through the 4-year investment period, then eligible for Permanent Resident Visa
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: at least 117 days over the 4-year investment period

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand -- Active Investor Plus Visa: NZD 15 million standard (NZD 5 million Direct-Investment-only) threshold, sub-category minimums, 117-day presence requirement over 4 years, no English language requirement, path to Permanent Resident Visa

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (New Zealand). Notably no English-language requirement is imposed at this stage, per the tier-1 source -- unlike this dataset's usual naturalisation English requirements which apply later at nz_citizenship_by_grant.json. citizenship_after_months modeled as the standard nz_citizenship_by_grant.json 5-year/1,350-day clock starting from resident-visa grant, running concurrently with (not stacked after) the 4-year investment period.
